steps.say: I'll screen every model and market for sell-in running ahead of sell-out in 2026-Q3, then check installed base, activations, app engagement and Smart Switch for the ones that stand out.

args.title: Sell-in vs sell-out screen, 2026-Q3
args.subtitle: Model-market pairs with sell-in at least 15% above sell-out. Screening only: no stock age, returns or approved threshold.

steps.answer:
**Five model–market pairs had sell-in at least 15% above sell-out in 2026-Q3; only EG Galaxy A37 combines that with stalling installed-base growth, and its demand signals point to channel loading rather than a demand problem.** Treat this as a screening result, not a diagnosis: there is no stock age, returns data or owner-approved threshold. All figures are SYNTHETIC test data.

[{table}]

**EG · Galaxy A37 — concerning (channel-loading pattern)**
- Sell-in 97,463 vs sell-out 62,880 units (1.55×) [{flow}]; channel stock rose from 24,092 in June [{stock_june}] to 58,675 in September [{flow}].
- Installed base fell 0.5% in Q3 (677,360 → 673,979) after growing 4.2% in Q2 [{ib}].
- Only 45,274 activations against 62,880 sell-out (72%) [{activations}], and the 30-day active rate of new devices is 61% [{app}].
- Weak demand indicators while stock builds is consistent with channel stuffing, or with sell-out reported but not activated. Smart Switch is reported by family (S/A/Z), not by model, so it cannot isolate the A37 [{switch}].

**AE · Galaxy Z Flip8 — likely launch pipeline fill**
- Sell-in 20,295 vs sell-out 12,300 (1.65×) in its launch quarter [{flow}], but activations track sell-out (98%) [{activations}] and 93% of new devices are still active after 30 days [{app}]. Watch whether the 7,995 units of stock [{flow}] sell down in Q4.

**SA · Galaxy A57 — contradictory signals**
- Sell-in 120,594 vs sell-out 103,960 (1.16×) with stock up from 36,620 [{stock_june}] to 53,254 [{flow}] looks like loading, yet installed base grew 4.5% (faster than Q2's 4.2%) [{ib}] and activations matched sell-out (99%) [{activations}]. Demand looks real; stock age would settle it.

**MA · Galaxy A17 — cannot be assessed**
- Sell-in 29,997 vs sell-out 22,220 (1.35×) [{flow}], but Morocco's app-engagement feed is missing for September [{app}], so the demand side is incomplete. Missing data is not evidence of weak demand.

**Healthy reference:** SA Galaxy S26 Ultra sold in and out at the same pace (54,783 vs 54,240) [{flow}].

**Next questions**
- Show EG Galaxy A37 sell-in, sell-out and activations by month for 2026.
- Is a partner-level GSCM report available to see which distributors hold the EG A37 stock?
